So maybe we can't change directory. But we can list /tmp? The ls tool doesn't accept path. So we can't list /tmp. But maybe we can use find with path? find can search under a path. So we can find path="/tmp" name=None. That will list all files under /tmp recursively. But we want to list all files in /tmp including hidden. find will include hidden? It says find any file or directories under specific path that contain name in its file name. It searches recursively. It doesn't mention hidden. But likely includes hidden. So we can call find with path="/tmp". Then we can list. But we also want to list hidden files. find will include hidden. So let's do that.
